evidence.obsidian_context: client-esteban-media/wiki/esteban-nap-audit-2026-08-15.md. The NAP audit read the live Google Business Profile and found two defects: the profile carries no phone number, and the site's LocalBusiness node carries no address. This PR fixes the second. The first cannot be fixed from here - the Business Information API returns PHONE_NUMBER_EDITS_NOT_ALLOWED - and is recorded as a UI action for Gonzalo.

evidence.hard_stops_checked: Checked and clear. No price, offer or turnaround claim touched. No street address published - the addition is locality, region and country only, and the test pins streetAddress as absent. No credential read into the diff. No route added or removed, sitemap unchanged at 269. No outreach performed.
evidence.reviewer_ensemble: builder pass, skeptic pass, taste pass - see the reviewer_ensemble object.
evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: The skeptic pressed on the obvious adjacent change: if we are adding an address, add postalCode and geo coordinates too and give Google a full pin. Rejected on evidence rather than taste. The live profile is CUSTOMER_LOCATION_ONLY with storefrontAddress null and latlng null, so any postal code or coordinate published here would be an assertion the profile does not make, which is the exact entity split the citation packet exists to prevent. A second point was raised and acted on: an earlier draft of the audit claimed the visible footer had no city line. Reading components/site-footer-client.tsx and then the production HTML showed the footer already renders site.location in the copyright line. The claim was wrong and was corrected before this PR was written; the test now asserts the schema city equals site.location so the two cannot drift.
evidence.winner_rationale: address is the field LocalBusiness is defined around, and areaServed does not substitute for it - areaServed is where the work happens, address is where the business is. Adding locality/region/country is the maximum that can be published truthfully for a service-area business whose profile hides its address. The alternative, leaving address absent and relying on areaServed plus visible text, is what shipped and what the audit found wanting.
